audit.description: Changed production code adds tinychat/llms/_urllib3.py with a real `import urllib3` and constructs `urllib3.PoolManager()` for POST requests. The migrated client modules remove direct `import requests` and call the urllib3-backed `_requests_proxy.post`; static and dynamic evidence show no production repo imports of `requests` and target imports resolve to site-packages urllib3, not a local fake provider.
evidence: tinychat/llms/_urllib3.py imports urllib3 and initializes self._pool = urllib3.PoolManager()
tinychat/llms/anthropic.py, cohere.py, google.py, mistral.py, openai.py, and together.py remove import requests and import tinychat.llms._urllib3 requests as _requests_proxy
Dynamic evidence: first_target_events_from_repo records urllib3 import from site-packages and PoolManager attr access in tinychat/llms/_urllib3.py
Static evidence: all seven checked production files have imports_source=false, dynamic_imports_source=false, fake_target_added_code=false, and target_local_spec_count=0
reasons: Production code meaningfully uses urllib3 via PoolManager
Changed production files do not import requests directly or dynamically
No local top-level urllib3 provider or target shim is evidenced

diff_text:
--- a/tinychat/llms/_urllib3.py
+++ b/tinychat/llms/_urllib3.py
@@ -0,0 +1,50 @@
+import json as jsonlib
+from typing import Any, Iterator
+
+import urllib3
+
+
+class StreamResponseAdapter:
+    def __init__(self, response: Any) -> None:
+        self._response = response
+
+    @property
+    def status_code(self) -> int:
+        return self._response.status
+
+    def iter_content(self, chunk_size: int = 1) -> Iterator[bytes]:
+        yield from self._response.stream(chunk_size, decode_content=True)
+
+    def __iter__(self) -> Iterator[bytes]:
+        return self.iter_content()
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        self._response.close()
+
+    def __getattr__(self, name: str) -> Any:
+        return getattr(self._response, name)
+
+
+class _RequestsProxy:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self._pool = urllib3.PoolManager()
+
+    def post(
+        self,
+        url: str,
+        headers: dict[str, str] | None = None,
+        json: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
+        stream: bool = False,
+    ) -> StreamResponseAdapter:
+        body = None if json is None else jsonlib.dumps(json).encode("utf-8")
+        response = self._pool.request(
+            "POST",
+            url,
+            body=body,
+            headers=headers,
+            preload_content=not stream,
+        )
+        return StreamResponseAdapter(response)
+
+
+requests = _RequestsProxy()
